node.statement: A continuous linear map between Banach spaces commutes with a Bochner contour integral: applying iota_n to Riemann sums for the integral and taking the norm limit gives iota_n(integral_Gamma F(lambda) d lambda)=integral_Gamma iota_n(F(lambda)) d lambda. Apply this to F(lambda)=theta(lambda)(lambda 1-T)^{-1}; node 1.3.1 identifies iota_n((lambda 1-T)^{-1}) with (lambda 1-iota_n(T))^{-1}. Therefore, under the extra contour-functional-calculus hypothesis of node 1.3, theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This remains only conditional and supplies no identification of the theta in def-compressed-corner.
